text:
sam (Docs): Hi all — opened a small PR adding a preflight-net-check script for Private installs that validates DNS, MTU, and HSM reachability (OCSP + TLS handshake). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4207. Need infra & security eyes for the HSM checks.

viv (Eng-Platform): Nice. Can the script include an `openssl s_client` example and an explicit `sha256sum --check` step before bundle import? Ops like concrete commands.

ana (Eng-Infra): Also include a small `ethtool -S` note for NIC offload issues and a `ping -s` MTU test. Customers hit TCP MSS clamping on some middleboxes.

sam (Docs): Draft excerpt below (non-prod):

```
# verify bundle checksum
sha256sum --check offline-bundle.sha256

# test MTU
ping -c 3 -s 1400 10.0.5.20

# TLS/OCSP probe (HSM)
openssl s_client -connect 10.0.5.30:15000 -servername hsm.internal -status < /dev/null
# look for "OCSP response: good" and verify certificate chain
```

owen (Security): Good start. For OCSP, warn that some HSMs don't provide OCSP and we recommend a cert validity window check as fallback. Also redact any real CNs in examples and add a short paragraph on minimal KMS roles (bundle:upload + kms:aead-decrypt for bootstrap).

tess (Support): From tickets: sometimes `systemd-resolved` and local dnsmasq race. Suggest a one-liner to test resolution: `dig @127.0.0.1 hsm.internal` and a fallback to test 8.8.8.8. Also add a systemd ExecStartPre loop that waits for DNS + proxy before running installer. I can draft that.

sam (Docs): Adding a tiny Go SDK upload snippet so infra teams can use our CLI-less flow (redacted token):

```
// minimal Go upload
client := &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)}}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://10.0.5.20:8443/api/bundles", body)
req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer REDACTED")
resp, err := client.Do(req)
```

viv (Eng-Platform): Perfect. Also add quick troubleshooting table: symptom -> check 1 -> check 2 (e.g., TLS handshake fails -> verify MTU -> run s_client with -msg).

link-checker: linkcheck: failed anchor /private/install/preflight -> 404.

sam (Docs): Thanks link-checker — I'll update anchor to `#preflight-network-validation` and push commits: add openssl/ocsp guidance, sha256 check, ethtool note, Go snippet, and support ExecStartPre check. Tagging @viv @ana @owen @tess for quick LGTM after push. :thumbsup:
